name: herdr-agent-usage
notes: Not a billing-product list: excluded from provider-census.sh's total by kind. The relevant import per issue #2006 is this source's SEPARATION of agent identity from billing mode. internal/providers/ registers six agent-identity modules (claude, codex, cursor, grok, omp, opencode; recorded here as entries for the record). internal/limits/billingmode.go (read at this revision) classifies BillingSubscription vs BillingPayAsYouGo per pane from account/session evidence (e.g. claude: ~/.claude.json oauthAccount.billingType or CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK/VERTEX/FOUNDRY env flags; codex: rollout token_count with/without rate_limits; opencode: assistant message providerID; grok: auth.json auth_mode). Also noted: internal/providers/omp/provider.go registers TWO UsageProviders from one module, agent ids "omp" and "pi" ("stock Pi coding agent") — so the identity count is not exactly 1:1 with the directory count; not resolved further here since this source is a reference, not a counted provider list.
